SAME state means recorded model_state_sha equality; whole artifact identities can differ.
V fingerprints are compared on the same cohort/data/scaler. This renderer performs no weight/NPZ replay or independent rescore.
A repeated selected model is evidence of actual search with unchanged selection, not a 3-epoch accuracy gain or no training.
